g.text: A query is answered by the first layer that matches: blocklist, Redis cache, MongoDB records, then upstream DNS

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 250, 252), rgb(21, 23, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(148, 163, 184), rgb(87, 100, 118));

text.tspan: Any resolver on the network
dig, Resolve-DnsName, OS stub resolver

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 250, 252), rgb(21, 23, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(148, 163, 184), rgb(87, 100, 118));

text.tspan: Operator on the host machine
Opens the dashboard over loopback

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(239, 246, 255), rgb(21, 27, 35)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(37, 99, 235), rgb(105, 158, 255));

text.tspan: node:dgram with dns-packet
Decodes the query and encodes the answer

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(245, 243, 255), rgb(28, 26, 36)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(124, 58, 237), rgb(197, 141, 255));

text.tspan: Express 5, bound to loopback, no auth
Static UI plus a REST API

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 253, 250), rgb(14, 25, 23)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(15, 118, 110), rgb(86, 174, 167));

text.tspan: Four layer resolution
Stops at the first layer that answers

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(254, 242, 242), rgb(35, 25, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(220, 38, 38), rgb(255, 138, 138));

text.tspan: In-memory Set, O(1) lookup
A gives 0.0.0.0, AAAA gives ::, every
other type gives an empty answer

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 251, 235), rgb(25, 22, 8)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(217, 119, 6), rgb(197, 113, 16));

text.tspan: RRsets keyed by name:type, follows CNAMEs
Upstream answers only, written back after
a reply and expiring on its TTL

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 253, 244), rgb(15, 26, 19)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(21, 128, 61), rgb(82, 174, 116));

text.tspan: Source of truth, never cached
A, AAAA, CNAME, MX and TXT, with PTR
derived from your A records

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 249, 255), rgb(18, 26, 31)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(3, 105, 161), rgb(89, 177, 225));

text.tspan: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, then Google 8.8.8.8
The next resolver is tried after 2s
The reply is cached in Redis

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(254, 242, 242), rgb(35, 25, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(220, 38, 38), rgb(255, 138, 138));

text.tspan: Durable list of blocked names
Reloaded into the Set at startup and
after every edit, with no restart

g.text: MongoDB and Redis stay internal to the Compose network. Only ports 53 and 8053 are published, and 8053 is bound to loopback.
